TopSites is one switch over 15 action types plus guards, so lizard charges ~27 branches. Extracting the settings, preview and row-update cases into three module-level pure switch helpers (ccn ~13, ~9 and ~9), and routing via two module-level Sets, leaves TopSites with two membership checks. Each helper reproduces its original branch bodies exactly, so return values and referential identity (prevState for no-ops/missing data, new objects for updates) are unchanged, and no helper exceeds the limit.

Lizard double-counts each of the 11 `??` operators in PictureOfTheDay, inflating CCN to 24 even though the function is a flat one-case switch. Moving the per-field defaulting into a module-level helper that iterates a field/fallback map leaves exactly one `??` there (CCN well under 15) and reduces the reducer to two branches. Spread order (prevState, normalized fields, initialized:true) and `??` semantics with identical fallbacks keep values, key order, null/undefined handling, and prevState identity for other actions unchanged.

handlePlacesEvent's CCN is inflated by two long inlined boolean predicates and three post-loop guards. Moving the bookmark-added skip test and the bookmark-removed test into module-level helpers preserves short-circuit evaluation order and identical truth values, including the `continue` path. Extracting the three ordered, guarded dispatches into flushRemovals keeps payloads and dispatch order identical. The method then has only the switch/loop branches plus helper calls, well under 15, and every helper is far below the limit.

onAction's CCN comes from two dense case bodies. attempt's CCN 29 comes from two dense blocks: opt-in/geolocation resolution and the forecast-widget boolean. Moving the entire !locationName branch into _resolveGeolocation keeps the merino-first guard, opt-in gate, geolocation failure and invalid-field paths (each still returns the same empty result via null), and geolocation errors still reject inside attempt's try/catch, so retries are unchanged. The extraction removes 11+5 decision points and adds 2 (ternary and null check), leaving attempt at 15, with both helpers far below the limit; the diff is 79 lines.
